desc:
🦖 Become a giant dinosaur and smash a whole town! Chomp fleeing townsfolk, or switch sides and survive as a human.

🏙️ Fully destructible town: buildings crumble, towers and the Ferris wheel topple, the roller coaster breaks, water towers burst
🦴 Grab and throw people, trees, cars and benches, then stomp, charge and roar to freeze everyone nearby in fear
🦕 Level up to unlock 9 dinos, from Raptor and Spinosaurus to Triceratops and Ankylosaurus, each with a special move like fire breath or meteor call
📈 Your dino grows bigger as you level
😱 Screaming townsfolk flop and fly with real ragdoll physics
🌋 Random server events: Volcano Eruption with 2x XP, Meteor Shower, Golden Human, Rush Hour and a colossal roaming TITAN
🏆 Quests, combo XP and global leaderboards
🔄 The town rebuilds itself, so the chaos never ends
📱 Play on PC, phone and tablet

⭐ Favourite the game and join our community for updates and events!
